title: Beyond the Smokestack: Supply Chains and the Industrial Incidence of Net Zero
title_zh: 超越烟囱：供应链与净零排放的工业影响
title_primary: 超越烟囱：供应链与净零排放的工业影响
title_secondary: Beyond the Smokestack: Supply Chains and the Industrial Incidence of Net Zero
authors: Eric Jondeau, Côme Poirier, Gauthier Vermandel
official: 官方在线 2026-08-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the industrial incidence of net zero in DICE-IO, a 33-sector climate-economy model calibrated to global input--output data. The standard smokestack principle suggests that the largest direct emitters should bear the largest transition burden. We show that this incidence logic breaks down in a production network: carbon costs propagate downstream and can weigh most heavily on industries that use carbon-intensive inputs. We summarize this mechanism with a sufficient statistic for first-order price incidence, the Leontief-based embodied-emissions multiplier, which we call Downstream Emission Centrality (DEC). DEC equals the sectoral price response to a marginal Scope-1 carbon tax and explains nearly all cross-sectional price variation along the nonlinear net-zero transition. Achieving the Paris Agreement target requires a carbon tax rising to about $1,300 per ton of CO2 by 2050. The Scope-1 transition has a consumption-equivalent welfare cost of 0.7% relative to laissez-faire, while a Scope-3-style tax on embodied carbon in purchases yields a welfare gain of 1.1%.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了DICE-IO模型中净零排放的产业影响，该模型是一个校准至全球投入产出数据的33部门气候经济模型。标准的“烟囱原则”认为，直接排放量最大的行业应承担最大的转型负担。我们表明，这种影响逻辑在生产网络中失效：碳成本向下游传导，可能对使用碳密集型投入的行业影响最为沉重。我们通过一个充分统计量来概括这一机制，用于一阶价格影响，即基于列昂惕夫的隐含排放乘数，我们称之为下游排放中心性（DEC）。DEC等于部门对边际范围一碳税的价格响应，并解释了非线性净零转型中几乎所有的横截面价格变动。实现巴黎协定目标要求碳税到2050年升至每吨二氧化碳约1300美元。相对于放任自流，范围一转型的消费等价福利成本为0.7%，而对购买中隐含碳征收范围三式税收则带来1.1%的福利收益。

title: Media Sentiment on Foreign Countries and International Asset Allocation
title_zh: 媒体对外国情绪与国际资产配置
title_primary: 媒体对外国情绪与国际资产配置
title_secondary: Media Sentiment on Foreign Countries and International Asset Allocation
authors: Baixiao Liu, Linlin Ma
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine whether U.S. media sentiment on foreign countries influences domestic investors’ international asset allocation. Using flows to country-specific mutual funds as a proxy for investor demand, we find that negative media sentiment, measured by the interaction of negative tone and media attention given to foreign countries, is strongly associated with reduced investor flows into funds targeting those countries. This relationship is driven, at least in part, by media sentiment that is unrelated to the economic fundamentals of the targeted countries. We employ The Wall Street Journal’s acquisition by News Corp to support the causal interpretation of our findings. Our results highlight the perception-shaping role of media narratives in driving global investment decisions. This paper was accepted by Will Cong, finance. Funding: L. Ma acknowledges funding support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72103008]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05504 .
abstract_zh: 我们考察了美国媒体对外国的情绪是否影响国内投资者的国际资产配置。以针对特定国家的共同基金资金流动作为投资者需求的代理指标，我们发现，负面媒体情绪——通过负面语气与对外国媒体关注度的交互作用来衡量——与流向这些国家基金的资金减少密切相关。这一关系至少部分由与目标国家经济基本面无关的媒体情绪所驱动。我们利用《华尔街日报》被新闻集团收购的事件来支持我们发现的因果解释。我们的结果凸显了媒体叙事在塑造认知、推动全球投资决策中的作用。本文被金融学编辑Will Cong接受。资助：L. Ma感谢国家自然科学基金[批准号72103008]的资助支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05504获取。

title: Emergency land take, road-network centrality and post-disaster land-use policy: Evidence from the post-earthquake reconstruction of L’Aquila, Italy
title_zh: 紧急土地征收、路网中心性与灾后土地利用政策：来自意大利拉奎拉震后重建的证据
title_primary: 紧急土地征收、路网中心性与灾后土地利用政策：来自意大利拉奎拉震后重建的证据
title_secondary: Emergency land take, road-network centrality and post-disaster land-use policy: Evidence from the post-earthquake reconstruction of L’Aquila, Italy
authors: Federico Mara, Cristina Montaldi, Francesco Zullo, Valerio Cutini
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Land-use policy increasingly operates under conditions of shock and uncertainty, yet the mechanisms through which emergency measures produce persistent land take remain underexplored. In this paper, land take refers to land development involving the conversion of natural, semi-natural or agricultural land to artificial uses, often associated with impervious soil cover. The paper examines how post-earthquake road-access restrictions, safety cordons, and infrastructure-and-amenity siting choices interacted with road-network centrality and land-use change in L’Aquila, Italy. Using a configurational approach, namely Space Syntax, on reconstructed pre-earthquake and post-earthquake road networks, we compute segment-based Integration (NAIN) and Choice (NACH) at multiple radii and relate centrality deciles to a 2014 post-event census of commercial and public amenities through nearest-segment association and buffer-based sensitivity tests. Results show a strong spatial alignment between road closures in and around the historic centre, the emergence of high-centrality road corridors, notably Viale della Croce Rossa and the SS17, and the concentration of post-disaster amenities along those corridors and their immediate surroundings. Two peripheral district centres, Torrione and Torretta, also consolidated as locally autonomous service nuclei, reinforcing a more polycentric pattern that only partly aligned with statutory planning objectives. Rather than proposing a formal predictive model, the paper uses single-case evidence to show how road-network diagnostics can help identify corridors where temporary land uses and emergency-related land take are most likely to persist; support decisions on the reopening of strategic road links; and inform time-bound rules for de-commissioning, reuse, regularisation, and development caps on floor area and intensity. The workflow is low-cost, open-data based and transferable to other hazards and city sizes, providing actionable evidence for planners and governments seeking to align post-disaster responses with land-take control objectives.
abstract_zh: 土地政策日益在冲击与不确定性条件下运作，然而紧急措施如何导致持续性土地占用（land take）的机制仍未得到充分探讨。本文中，土地占用指涉及将自然、半自然或农业用地转化为人工用途的土地开发，通常与不透水地表覆盖相关。本文考察了意大利拉奎拉地震后道路通行限制、安全警戒线以及基础设施与便利设施选址如何与道路网络中心性和土地利用变化相互作用。采用构形方法，即空间句法（Space Syntax），对重建的地震前与地震后道路网络进行分析，我们计算了多半径下的分段整合度（NAIN）和选择度（NACH），并通过最近路段关联和缓冲区敏感性检验，将中心性十分位数与2014年震后商业及公共便利设施普查数据进行关联。结果显示，历史中心及其周边的道路封闭、高中心性道路走廊（尤其是红十字大道和SS17公路）的出现，以及灾后便利设施沿这些走廊及其邻近区域的集中，之间存在显著的空间对应关系。两个外围区域中心——托里奥内和托雷塔——也巩固为地方自治的服务节点，强化了一种仅与法定规划目标部分吻合的多中心格局。本文并未提出正式预测模型，而是利用单案例证据展示道路网络诊断如何有助于识别临时性土地利用和紧急相关土地占用最可能持续存在的走廊；支持战略道路连接重新开放的决策；并为退役、再利用、规范化以及建筑面积和强度开发上限提供有时限的规则依据。该工作流程成本低廉、基于开放数据，并可推广至其他灾害类型和城市规模，为规划者和政府提供可操作证据，以将灾后响应与土地占用控制目标相协调。

title: How Environmental Provisions in Regional Trade Agreements Drive Agri‐Food Export Quality Upgrading?—A Regulatory Perspective
title_zh: 区域贸易协定中的环境条款如何推动农产品出口质量升级？——基于规制视角的分析
title_primary: 区域贸易协定中的环境条款如何推动农产品出口质量升级？——基于规制视角的分析
title_secondary: How Environmental Provisions in Regional Trade Agreements Drive Agri‐Food Export Quality Upgrading?—A Regulatory Perspective
authors: Ronghua Zhai, Hongman Liu
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Environmental provisions have become important to Regional Trade Agreements (RTAs) and are key in promoting high‐quality trade. Using matched data from China Industrial Enterprise Database and China Customs Database, this study explores the non‐linear impact of the depth of RTA environmental provisions on agri‐food export quality upgrading and its mechanisms. Results show a significant ‘U‐shaped’ effect; beyond a 0.48 depth threshold, environmental provisions exert a sustained positive impact on agri‐food export quality upgrading. Heterogeneity analysis reveals divergent effects across national, firm, product quality and specific provision dimensions, with the ‘Balance between environment and trade/investment’ clause being the dominant influencing factor. We further reveal that cost constraints and innovation compensation effects are the key drivers behind the nonlinear impact. Therefore, this study benchmarks against high‐standard international trade rules and proposes policy recommendations for achieving high‐quality agricultural development.
abstract_zh: 环境条款已成为区域贸易协定（RTAs）的重要组成部分，并在推动高质量贸易中发挥关键作用。本研究利用中国工业企业数据库与中国海关数据库的匹配数据，探讨了RTA环境条款深度对农产品出口质量升级的非线性影响及其作用机制。研究结果显示，存在显著的“U型”效应；当深度阈值超过0.48时，环境条款对农产品出口质量升级产生持续的积极影响。异质性分析揭示了在国家、企业、产品质量及具体条款维度上的差异化效应，其中“环境与贸易/投资平衡”条款是主导影响因素。我们进一步揭示，成本约束与创新补偿效应是非线性影响背后的关键驱动力。因此，本研究以高标准国际经贸规则为基准，提出了实现农业高质量发展的政策建议。

title: Expected foreign military intervention and demand for state-building: Evidence from Mali
title_zh: 预期外国军事干预与国家建设需求：来自马里的证据
title_primary: 预期外国军事干预与国家建设需求：来自马里的证据
title_secondary: Expected foreign military intervention and demand for state-building: Evidence from Mali
authors: Alessandro Belmonte, Désirée Teobaldelli, Davide Ticchi
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study how the announcement of a foreign military intervention, which improves expectations about the state’s future functioning, can raise citizens’ willingness to participate in state-building processes. We analyze the impact of the 2012 United Nations Security Council resolution that authorized intervention in Mali to reunify the country and restore democracy during a profound institutional crisis on individuals’ attitudes toward the state. By exploiting the randomness of the foreign intervention announcement relative to the timeline of the Afrobarometer interviews conducted in South Mali, we document that individuals interviewed in the days after the announcement report more optimistic beliefs about the country’s future level of democracy than individuals interviewed immediately before, with the same characteristics, region, and ethnic group. Consistent with a prospective-beliefs channel, respondents interviewed after the announcement report higher tax morale and more favorable tax-related attitudes across a broad range of outcomes. While optimism about future democracy increases widely, the increase in tax morale appears concentrated in areas with low state capacity, limited ethnic diversity, and individuals who do not perceive discrimination against their ethnic group. Our results indicate that foreign military interventions can enhance perceptions of state-building and the benefits of participation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了外国军事干预的宣布如何通过改善对国家未来运作的预期，提升公民参与国家建设进程的意愿。我们分析了2012年联合国安理会授权在马里进行干预以在深刻制度危机期间实现国家统一和恢复民主的决议，对个人对国家态度的影响。利用外国干预宣布相对于南马里进行的非洲晴雨表访谈时间线的随机性，我们记录了在宣布后几天接受访谈的个人，相较于在宣布前立即接受访谈、具有相同特征、地区和族群的个体，报告了对国家未来民主水平更为乐观的信念。与前瞻性信念渠道一致，宣布后受访的个体在广泛的结果范围内报告了更高的税收道德和更有利的税收相关态度。尽管对未来民主的乐观情绪普遍上升，但税收道德的提高似乎集中在国家能力较低、族群多样性有限以及不认为自身族群受到歧视的个体所在的地区。我们的结果表明，外国军事干预可以增强对国家建设及参与益处的认知。

title: The Demand for Mobility: Evidence From an Experiment With Uber Riders
title_zh: 出行需求：来自优步乘客实验的证据
title_primary: 出行需求：来自优步乘客实验的证据
title_secondary: The Demand for Mobility: Evidence From an Experiment With Uber Riders
authors: Peter Christensen, Gustavo Nino, Adam Osman
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Changes in transport costs can affect mobility in ways that differ across the population, affecting the impacts of transport policies. We randomly assign large price reductions on Uber in Egypt over a 3-month period and collect comprehensive data on participant mobility using Google Timeline. A 50% price reduction quadruples Uber usage and induces a 42% increase in total travel. Effects and welfare gains are larger for women, who are less mobile at baseline and perceive public transit as unsafe. The price elasticity of private vehicle kilometers traveled (-1.28) implies that mobility and external costs increase substantially when ride-hailing prices fall.
abstract_zh: 运输成本的变化可能以不同方式影响不同人群的流动性，从而影响交通政策的效应。我们在埃及对Uber实施为期三个月的大幅降价随机分配，并利用Google Timeline收集参与者流动性的全面数据。降价50%使Uber使用量翻两番，并导致总出行量增加42%。对于基线流动性较低且认为公共交通不安全的女性，其影响和福利收益更为显著。私人车辆行驶公里数的价格弹性（-1.28）表明，当网约车价格下降时，流动性和外部成本会大幅增加。

title: The changing geography of banking in CESEE. Branch closures outpace openings
title_zh: 中东欧及东南欧银行业地理格局变迁：分行关闭速度超过新设
title_primary: 中东欧及东南欧银行业地理格局变迁：分行关闭速度超过新设
title_secondary: The changing geography of banking in CESEE. Branch closures outpace openings
authors: Beckmann, Elisabeth & Weinel, Jette Leonie
official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the evolution of bank branch networks in ten CESEE countries between 2013 and 2021. Using a manually compiled dataset of all branches and their geocoordinates, we document a decline exceeding 30%, with substantial heterogeneity across and within countries. We show that banking market consolidation is a key driver of closures, while profitability and local economic growth mitigate them. Branches in highly urban or very rural areas close more often. Competitive effects are nonlinear: moderate clustering lowers closure risk, but intense competition increases it. These patterns differ markedly across CESEE banking systems during the entire period we analyze. JEL Classification: D53, G21, R12
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2013年至2021年间十个中东欧及东南欧国家（CESEE）银行分支网络的变化。基于手动编制的全部分支机构及其地理坐标数据集，我们记录了超过30%的降幅，且各国及国内各地区存在显著异质性。研究表明，银行市场整合是分支机构关闭的关键驱动因素，而盈利能力和地方经济增长则能缓解这一趋势。高度城市化或偏远地区的分支机构关闭频率更高。竞争效应呈现非线性特征：适度集聚降低关闭风险，但激烈竞争则增加该风险。在我们分析的整个时期内，这些模式在CESEE各银行体系中存在显著差异。JEL分类号：D53, G21, R12

title: Attribute Dependence and the Provision of Quality
title_zh: 属性依赖与质量供给
title_primary: 属性依赖与质量供给
title_secondary: Attribute Dependence and the Provision of Quality
authors: Hans Degryse, Andreas Irmen, Costas Hadjiyiannis, Sofronis Clerides, Roman Inderst 等
official: 官方在线 1997-04-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies firms? incentives to provide quality when this decision affects the goods? degree of horizontal differentiation. Intuitively, one is inclined to argue that private incentives to provide quality are insufficient relative to the social optimum if a quality improvement reduces horizontal differentiation. We find that this argument depends on whether the game is simultaneous or sequential. In the former case private incentives prove excessive relative to the social optimum, and in the latter case, insufficient. As a result, a regulator might want to impose either minimum or maximum quality standards.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了当质量决策影响商品水平差异化程度时，企业提供质量的激励问题。直观上，人们倾向于认为，若质量提升会降低水平差异化，则私人提供质量的激励相对于社会最优水平将不足。我们发现，这一论点取决于博弈是同时进行还是序贯进行。在前一种情形下，私人激励相对于社会最优水平表现为过度；在后一种情形下则表现为不足。因此，监管者可能需设定最低或最高质量标准。

title: The dual role of crop-livestock diversification in household nutrition security: Evidence from rural Ethiopia
title_zh: 作物-牲畜多样化在家庭营养安全中的双重作用：来自埃塞俄比亚农村的证据
title_primary: 作物-牲畜多样化在家庭营养安全中的双重作用：来自埃塞俄比亚农村的证据
title_secondary: The dual role of crop-livestock diversification in household nutrition security: Evidence from rural Ethiopia
authors: Taye Melese Mekie, Luchen Huang, Yanjun Ren, Tadie Mirie Abate
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Nutrition insecurity remains a pressing global challenge, and while crop-livestock diversification offers a promising strategy to improve household nutrition, its relationship with micronutrient consumption remains underexplored. Using panel data from the Ethiopian Socio-economic Survey (ESS) from 2018/19 to 2021/22, this study examines the role of crop-livestock diversification in household nutrition security in rural Ethiopia and explores the underlying pathways. Three aspects of farm production diversity are considered: crop-livestock diversification, crop diversification, and livestock diversification. The results indicate that crop-livestock, crop, and livestock diversification are positively associated with total and own-produced nutrient intake but negatively associated with nutrient intake from market-purchased foods. The findings further indicate that the nutritional benefits of diversification are generally stronger among households with better market access, while heterogeneity by shock exposure is more limited and nutrient-specific. The pathway analysis suggests that the relationship between crop-livestock diversification and nutrition outcomes operates through total food consumption, own-produced consumption, market-purchased consumption, farm output, and income channels. Among these channels, total food consumption and own-produced consumption represent the strongest channels, while the income channel appears comparatively weaker. These findings highlight an important nutritional trade-off: diversification is associated with greater nutrient acquisition from household production while reducing nutrient consumption from market-purchased foods. The findings suggest that policies supporting crop-livestock diversification, together with complementary nutrition-sensitive and market-supporting interventions, may contribute to improved household nutrition security while addressing production–market trade-offs.
abstract_zh: 营养不安全仍然是全球面临的紧迫挑战，尽管作物-牲畜多样化被视为改善农户营养状况的一项有前景的策略，但其与微量营养素摄入之间的关系尚未得到充分探讨。本研究利用2018/19至2021/22年埃塞俄比亚社会经济调查（ESS）的面板数据，考察了作物-牲畜多样化在埃塞俄比亚农村家庭营养安全中的作用，并探讨了其潜在的作用路径。研究考虑了农业生产多样性的三个方面：作物-牲畜多样化、作物多样化和牲畜多样化。结果表明，作物-牲畜、作物和牲畜多样化与总营养摄入及自产营养摄入呈正相关，但与从市场购买食品中获得的营养摄入呈负相关。研究进一步发现，多样化的营养益处通常在市场准入条件较好的家庭中更为显著，而受冲击暴露的异质性影响较为有限且具有营养素特异性。路径分析表明，作物-牲畜多样化与营养结果之间的关系通过总食物消费、自产消费、市场购买消费、农业产出和收入渠道发挥作用。在这些渠道中，总食物消费和自产消费是最强的渠道，而收入渠道相对较弱。这些发现揭示了一个重要的营养权衡：多样化与从家庭生产中获取更多营养相关，同时减少了从市场购买食品中获得的营养摄入。研究结果表明，支持作物-牲畜多样化的政策，辅以营养敏感型和市场支持型干预措施，可能有助于改善农户营养安全，同时应对生产与市场之间的权衡。

title: News media as suppliers of narratives (and information)
title_zh: 新闻媒体作为叙事（及信息）的提供者
title_primary: 新闻媒体作为叙事（及信息）的提供者
title_secondary: News media as suppliers of narratives (and information)
authors: Kfir Eliaz, Ran Spiegler
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We present a model in which news media shape beliefs by providing information (signals about an exogenous state) and narratives (models of what determines outcomes). To amplify consumers' engagement, the media maximize their anticipatory utility. We characterize the optimal monopolistic media strategy, highlighting the synergy between false narratives and biased information. Consumer heterogeneity gives rise to a novel menu‐design problem due to an “equilibrium data externality” among consumers. The optimal menu includes false narratives, and can generate polarized beliefs and choices without any information transmission. False narratives and polarization also feature in a competitive version of our model, albeit coupled with complete information. Nevertheless, competition can make some consumers objectively worse off.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中新闻媒体通过提供信息（关于外生状态的信号）和叙事（解释结果决定因素的模型）来塑造信念。为提升消费者参与度，媒体最大化其预期效用。我们刻画了最优垄断媒体策略，揭示了虚假叙事与有偏信息之间的协同效应。消费者异质性引致了一个新颖的菜单设计问题，其根源在于消费者间存在的"均衡数据外部性"。最优菜单包含虚假叙事，且能在无任何信息传递的情况下催生极化信念与选择。在竞争性版本模型中，尽管伴随完全信息条件，虚假叙事与极化现象依然存在。然而，竞争可能使部分消费者的客观福利恶化。

title: Assessing the environmental implications of sustainable public procurement of food
title_zh: 评估可持续公共食品采购的环境影响
title_primary: 评估可持续公共食品采购的环境影响
title_secondary: Assessing the environmental implications of sustainable public procurement of food
authors: Michael Martin, Sofia Lingegård
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Sustainable public procurement (SPP) is increasingly recognized as a policy tool to improve the environmental performance of food systems, yet there is limited empirical evidence on how procurement strategies influence environmental outcomes. This study assesses the environmental implications of municipal food procurement in a rural Swedish region using life cycle assessment (LCA). Procurement data from Östersund Municipality were used to construct baseline and alternative scenarios that reflect policy targets and objectives, including increased sourcing of organic and local foods, substitution of beef with game or legumes, and reductions in plate waste. Environmental impacts were evaluated using the Impact World + method across multiple indicators, including climate change, eutrophication, biodiversity, toxicity, and resource use. The results show that procurement strategies have differing effects across impact categories. Measures targeting food composition and consumption, such as reducing beef consumption and plate waste, lead to consistent reductions across several indicators, whereas strategies focused on sourcing and production methods, such as organic and local, yield more mixed outcomes, with improvements in some categories but increases in others. Substituting minced beef with local game and reducing food waste result in the largest overall reductions, while increasing organic procurement leads to relatively small changes across most indicators. These findings highlight the importance of multi-indicator assessments and show that focusing on a single indicator, or target, risks overlooking trade-offs. The study provides empirical evidence supporting more targeted, evidence-based procurement strategies and highlights the need for improved life cycle inventory data.
abstract_zh: 可持续公共采购（SPP）日益被视为改善食品系统环境绩效的政策工具，然而关于采购策略如何影响环境结果的实证证据仍然有限。本研究采用生命周期评估（LCA）方法，评估瑞典某农村地区市政食品采购的环境影响。基于厄斯特松德市采购数据，构建了反映政策目标与指标的基准情景与替代情景，包括增加有机食品和本地食品采购、以野味或豆类替代牛肉、以及减少餐盘浪费。采用Impact World+方法，从气候变化、富营养化、生物多样性、毒性和资源利用等多个指标评估环境影响。结果表明，不同采购策略在各影响类别中产生差异化效果。针对食品构成与消费的措施（如减少牛肉消费和餐盘浪费）在多个指标上实现持续减排，而聚焦于采购与生产方式（如有机和本地化）的策略则呈现混合结果——部分指标改善，另一些指标恶化。以本地野味替代碎牛肉和减少食物浪费带来最大整体减排，而增加有机采购在多数指标上仅产生较小变化。这些发现凸显了多指标评估的重要性，并表明仅关注单一指标或目标可能忽视权衡取舍。本研究为制定更具针对性和循证性的采购策略提供了实证支持，并强调改进生命周期清单数据的必要性。

title: Bilateral Import Demand Elasticities and Balanced Trade Protection
title_zh: 双边进口需求弹性与平衡贸易保护
title_primary: 双边进口需求弹性与平衡贸易保护
title_secondary: Bilateral Import Demand Elasticities and Balanced Trade Protection
authors: Kee, Hiau Looi, Constantinescu, Cristina, Yotov, Yoto V.
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Recognizing that macroeconomic conditions determine aggregate trade imbalances, can tariffs eliminate bilateral trade deficits? The Balanced Trade Tariff Index (BTTI) is introduced as the uniform tariff that closes bilateral deficits while holding macroeconomic conditions fixed. The BTTI depends on bilateral, product-level import demand elasticities estimated using a translog GDP function applied to data from seven major economies. The novel elasticity estimates vary widely across importers, exporters, products, and trade directions. This heterogeneity lowers average implied tariffs relative to homogeneous-elasticity benchmarks, yet implies substantially higher tariffs are required for exporters of inelastic products, underscoring the limits of tariffs for balancing trade.
abstract_zh: 认识到宏观经济状况决定总体贸易失衡，关税能否消除双边贸易逆差？本文提出平衡贸易关税指数（BTTI），将其定义为在保持宏观经济条件不变的前提下消除双边逆差的统一关税。该指数依赖于基于超越对数GDP函数估算的双边产品层面进口需求弹性，数据涵盖七大主要经济体。新型弹性估计值在进口国、出口国、产品及贸易方向上呈现显著异质性。相较于同质性弹性基准，这种异质性降低了平均隐含关税水平，但意味着对非弹性产品出口国需征收更高关税，凸显了关税在平衡贸易方面的局限性。

title: Pension Liquidity Risk
title_zh: 青年性别工资差距研究：来自埃及、约旦和巴勒斯坦的启示
title_primary: 青年性别工资差距研究：来自埃及、约旦和巴勒斯坦的启示
title_secondary: Pension Liquidity Risk
authors: Jansen, Kristy, Klingler, Sven, Ranaldo, Angelo, Duijm, Patty
official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Pension funds use interest rate swaps to hedge the interest rate risk arising from their liabilities. Analyzing regulatory data on Dutch pension funds, we show that pension funds with worse funding ratios, indicating greater fragility, use swaps more aggressively. These swap positions expose pension funds to the risk of margin calls, which can exceed 6% of their total assets, when interest rates rise. Pension funds respond to realized margin calls by selling safe government bonds with medium-term maturities. This procyclical selling behavior adversely affects the prices of the sold bonds and thereby exposes pension funds to market liquidity risk.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2013年4月至2026年1月期间（每序列3,163个观测值）的每日EMBI（新兴市场债券指数）数据，分析了17个拉丁美洲国家及两个区域总体的主权债券利差的长期记忆特性。参数方法显示，所有19个序列均呈现分数积分特征，对数转换后利差的估计阶数介于0.97（乌拉圭）至1.22（洪都拉斯）之间。其中九个序列的置信区间上限超过1，表明冲击具有持久性效应；在自相关误差假设下（如Bloomfield模型），乌拉圭是唯一利差序列呈现均值回归特征的国家（其分数参数置信区间低于1）。上述结果在误差项设定（白噪声或自相关）及允许非线性确定性趋势的条件下均保持稳健。

title: Managers’ understanding of macroeconomic news, competitor influence, and firm performance: Evidence from consumer sentiment news
title_zh: 管理者对宏观经济新闻的理解、竞争对手影响与企业绩效：来自消费者情绪新闻的证据
title_primary: 管理者对宏观经济新闻的理解、竞争对手影响与企业绩效：来自消费者情绪新闻的证据
title_secondary: Managers’ understanding of macroeconomic news, competitor influence, and firm performance: Evidence from consumer sentiment news
authors: Mei Feng, Lian Fen Lee, Benda Yin
official: 官方在线 2026-06-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the association between managers' failure to incorporate macroeconomic news and firm performance, focusing on the role of competitors. Measuring this failure using the extent to which management revenue forecast errors reflect U.S. consumer sentiment, we find an asymmetric association. When firms underestimate consumer demand and underproduce, failing to incorporate consumer sentiment news is associated with worse performance, but when they overestimate demand and overproduce, no association exists. These results are consistent with competitors reacting differently to underproduction and overproduction, worsening firm performance in the case of underproduction but not necessarily in overproduction. Cross-sectional analyses reveal that the negative association is mainly present when U.S. consumer sentiment is important and strategic interactions are stronger, such as in markets with higher product similarity. Overall, our findings suggest that the performance consequences of forecast errors due to failure to understand macroeconomic information are nuanced and depend on competitors’ strategic actions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了管理者未能纳入宏观经济新闻与企业绩效之间的关联，重点关注竞争对手的作用。通过以管理层收入预测误差反映美国消费者情绪的程度来衡量这一失败，我们发现了一种不对称的关联。当企业低估消费者需求并减少生产时，未能纳入消费者情绪新闻与较差的绩效相关；但当企业高估需求并过度生产时，则不存在这种关联。这些结果与竞争对手对生产不足和生产过剩的不同反应一致，即在生产不足情况下会恶化企业绩效，而在生产过剩情况下则未必如此。横截面分析显示，这种负面关联主要出现在美国消费者情绪重要且战略互动更强的市场中，例如产品相似度较高的市场。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，因未能理解宏观经济信息而导致的预测误差对绩效的影响是微妙的，并取决于竞争对手的战略行动。

title: Income Inequality and Job Creation
title_zh: 收入不平等与就业创造
title_primary: 收入不平等与就业创造
title_secondary: Income Inequality and Job Creation
authors: Sebastian Doerr, Thomas Drechsel, Donggyu Lee
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We propose a novel channel through which rising income inequality affects job creation and macroeconomic outcomes. High-income households save relatively more in stocks and bonds but less in bank deposits. A rising top income share thereby increases the relative financing cost for bank-dependent firms, which in turn create fewer jobs compared to other firms. Exploiting variation in top income shares across US states and an instrumental variable strategy, we provide evidence for this channel. We then build a general equilibrium macroeconomic model with heterogeneous households and heterogeneous firms and calibrate it to our empirical estimates. The model shows that the secular rise in top incomes accounts for 13% of the decline in the employment share of small firms since 1980. Through the new channel, rising inequality also reduces the labor share and aggregate output. Model experiments show that ignoring the link between inequality and job creation understates welfare effects of income redistribution.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的传导渠道，通过该渠道，收入不平等加剧会影响就业创造和宏观经济结果。高收入家庭将更多储蓄配置于股票和债券，而较少存入银行存款。因此，顶层收入份额的上升提高了依赖银行融资的企业的相对融资成本，导致这些企业创造的就业岗位少于其他企业。利用美国各州顶层收入份额的差异以及工具变量策略，我们为这一传导渠道提供了证据。随后，我们构建了一个包含异质性家庭和异质性企业的一般均衡宏观经济模型，并根据实证估计结果对其进行校准。模型显示，自1980年以来，顶层收入份额的长期上升解释了小企业就业份额下降的13%。通过这一新渠道，收入不平等加剧还降低了劳动收入份额和总产出。模型实验表明，忽视不平等与就业创造之间的关联会低估收入再分配的福利效应。

title: From Gross to Net: Carbon Dioxide Removal in an Analytic Climate Economy
title_zh: 从毛到净：分析性气候经济中的二氧化碳移除
title_primary: 从毛到净：分析性气候经济中的二氧化碳移除
title_secondary: From Gross to Net: Carbon Dioxide Removal in an Analytic Climate Economy
authors: Felix Meier, Martin Quaas, Wilfried Rickels, Christian Traeger
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Carbon dioxide removal (CDR) is considered essential for climate change mitigation, yet its optimal role in climate policy remains unclear in the presence of non-permanent storage, energy constraints, and fossil fuel scarcity. We integrate CDR into an analytic integrated assessment model to derive general conditions for socially optimal CDR deployment. Within a linear carbon cycle model, we consider diﬀerent CDR pathways, including direct air carbon capture, ocean alkalinity enhancement, and ocean iron fertilization. Introducing CDR does not significantly alter the optimal carbon price and the incentive to reduce emissions. The impact of CDR on gross emissions mainly stems from the energy required to operate it. This impact, as well as the optimal deployment of CDR, depends on fossil fuel scarcity and the pace of renewable energy deployment. In high-damage scenarios, the optimal deployment of CDR occurs before and around the year 2100, consistent with temperature overshoot pathways.
abstract_zh: 二氧化碳移除（CDR）被视为减缓气候变化的关键手段，然而在存在非永久性封存、能源约束及化石燃料稀缺性的情况下，其在气候政策中的最优角色仍不明确。我们将CDR整合进一个分析性综合评估模型中，以推导社会最优CDR部署的一般条件。在线性碳循环模型框架内，我们考虑了不同的CDR路径，包括直接空气碳捕集、海洋碱度增强及海洋铁施肥。引入CDR并未显著改变最优碳价格及减排激励。CDR对总排放的影响主要源于其运行所需的能源。这一影响以及CDR的最优部署，取决于化石燃料的稀缺性和可再生能源部署的速度。在高损害情景下，CDR的最优部署发生在2100年前后，与温度过冲路径相一致。

title: A heterogeneous agent new Keynesian model of search frictions and public sector employment
title_zh: 搜索摩擦与公共部门就业的异质性主体新凯恩斯模型
title_primary: 搜索摩擦与公共部门就业的异质性主体新凯恩斯模型
title_secondary: A heterogeneous agent new Keynesian model of search frictions and public sector employment
authors: Pavlos Balamatsias
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I study how public sector employment affects aggregate output and employment. Although accounting for approximately 25% of the labour force in modern economies, the macroeconomic effects of public sector employment remain largely underexplored. I build a Heterogeneous Agent New Keynesian (HANK) model with unemployment risk, endogenous job destruction, sluggish vacancy creation, and public sector employment. This is the first HANK model to study this fiscal tool, allowing me to capture key labour dynamics and assess their joint role with unemployment risk in shaping the effectiveness of policy shocks. Calibrated to France, the model shows that public sector employment lowers unemployment and increases aggregate output with multipliers above unity, driven by (i) stronger demand, (ii) labour frictions limiting crowding out, and (iii) reduced unemployment risk –effects that decline in the absence of labour and nominal frictions, and disappear in a representative agent setup. Finally, compared to an increase in benefits, public sector employment is more effective in stimulating economic activity and welfare.
abstract_zh: 我研究了公共部门就业如何影响总产出与就业。尽管在现代经济中公共部门就业约占劳动力的25%，但其宏观经济效应在很大程度上仍未得到充分探讨。我构建了一个包含失业风险、内生性岗位破坏、缓慢的空缺创造以及公共部门就业的异质性代理人新凯恩斯（HANK）模型。这是首个研究这一财政工具的HANK模型，使我能够捕捉关键的劳动力动态，并评估其与失业风险在塑造政策冲击有效性方面的联合作用。以法国为校准对象，模型显示公共部门就业降低了失业率并提高了总产出，乘数大于1，这得益于（i）更强的需求，（ii）限制挤出效应的劳动力摩擦，以及（iii）降低的失业风险——这些效应在缺乏劳动力和名义摩擦时减弱，并在代表性代理人设定中消失。最后，与增加福利相比，公共部门就业在刺激经济活动和福利方面更为有效。

title: Public Services Under Private Management
title_zh: 私营管理下的公共服务
title_primary: 私营管理下的公共服务
title_secondary: Public Services Under Private Management
authors: MaÍra Coube, Luiz Felipe Fontes, Rudi Rocha
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Theory predicts that outsourcing public services to the private sector can reduce costs and improve efficiency, but can also induce cost-cutting and compromise quality. We assess the Brazilian “Organizações Sociais de Saude” model (OSS), which outsources management of public hospital services to the private sector while the state remains the residual claimant. We show that this enhances hospital production and operational efficiency without adverse effects on hospital quality and equity. Increased inpatient production addresses previously unmet demand, expanding local access to hospital care and reducing population mortality. Performance gains arise from improved operational efficiency achieved through increased hospital management capacity. This facilitates staffing adjustments, favoring higher-skilled personnel, dismissing lower-productivity staff, and adopting flexible, performance-tied employment contracts. Effects are larger among private organizations with more management experience, underscoring returns to managerial capacity. Our findings show that incentive-ownership structures can address the quantity-quality trade-off in public service delivery, even when contracts are incomplete and quality is hard to measure.
abstract_zh: 理论预测，将公共服务外包给私营部门可降低成本并提高效率，但也可能引发成本削减并损害服务质量。我们评估了巴西的"健康社会组织"（OSS）模式——该模式将公立医院管理服务外包给私营部门，而国家仍保留剩余索取权。研究表明，该模式提升了医院产出与运营效率，且未对医院质量与公平性产生负面影响。住院服务量的增加满足了此前未被满足的需求，扩大了当地医院服务的可及性，并降低了人口死亡率。绩效提升源于医院管理能力增强带来的运营效率改善，这促进了人员结构调整——优先雇佣高技能人员、解雇低生产率员工，并采用灵活且与绩效挂钩的雇佣合同。在管理经验更丰富的私营组织中，效果更为显著，凸显了管理能力的回报。我们的发现表明，即使合同不完善且质量难以衡量，激励性所有权结构仍能解决公共服务供给中的数量-质量权衡问题。

title: Pluralistic ignorance and climate policies: Information provision experiment
title_zh: 多元无知与气候政策：信息提供实验
title_primary: 多元无知与气候政策：信息提供实验
title_secondary: Pluralistic ignorance and climate policies: Information provision experiment
authors: Laura Galdikiene, Jurate Jaraite, Agne Kajackaite
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines how informational interventions that aim to correct systematic misperceptions of others’ beliefs (i.e., pluralistic ignorance) affect individuals’ willingness to engage in both private and publicly observable behaviors. We investigate this question in the context of carbon taxation using an online experiment with participants in the United States. Specifically, we test whether providing accurate information about public support for carbon taxation influences climate-related actions. While this informational intervention reduced misperceptions, it marginally lowered private climate action, measured by donations to an organization advocating for climate policies, although this effect was not statistically significant. The intervention did not affect the behavior of individuals who underestimated support for carbon taxation but negatively impacted the donation decisions of those who overestimated support, suggesting a boomerang effect. In contrast, the intervention increased public climate action, measured by the minimum reward participants required to attend climate policy discussions with peers. These findings suggest that correcting misperceived norms can generate heterogeneous behavioral responses, depending on individuals’ prior beliefs and the type of action considered.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了旨在纠正对他人信念系统性误解（即多元无知）的信息干预如何影响个体参与私人及公开可观察行为的意愿。我们以碳税为背景，通过对美国参与者进行在线实验来考察这一问题。具体而言，我们测试了提供关于碳税公众支持度的准确信息是否会影响气候相关行为。尽管这种信息干预减少了误解，但它略微降低了私人气候行动——以向倡导气候政策的组织捐款为衡量指标，尽管这一效应在统计上并不显著。该干预并未影响低估碳税支持度的个体的行为，但对高估支持度的个体的捐款决策产生了负面影响，表明存在回旋镖效应。相比之下，该干预增加了公开气候行动——以参与者与同伴参加气候政策讨论所需的最低报酬为衡量指标。这些发现表明，纠正被误解的社会规范可能引发异质性行为反应，具体取决于个体先前的信念及所考虑的行为类型。

title: Segmentation and gender wage disparities in the early industrial workforce: Insights from Arkwright's Lumford Mill, 1786–1811
title_zh: 早期工业劳动力中的分割与性别工资差异：基于阿克莱特朗福德磨坊（1786–1811）的洞察
title_primary: 早期工业劳动力中的分割与性别工资差异：基于阿克莱特朗福德磨坊（1786–1811）的洞察
title_secondary: Segmentation and gender wage disparities in the early industrial workforce: Insights from Arkwright's Lumford Mill, 1786–1811
authors: Alexander Tertzakian
official: 官方在线 2026-04-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article examines the gender wage gap and wage setting in the early cotton spinning factories of the industrial revolution, with a specific focus on Richard Arkwright's Lumford Mill in Bakewell, Derbyshire. The research links workers from the mill's wage books with parish baptism records to estimate ages and construct age–wage profiles in the spinning department. Findings show a significant gender wage gap emerging in adulthood, with women's wages stagnating while men advanced to higher‐paying roles such as overseers, indicating limited advancement for women. However, there is little evidence of gender wage discrimination among child workers. The gendered segmentation of the spinning workforce towards adulthood was the main cause of the wage gap. The analysis also reveals that weekly wage rates for children increased annually until adulthood. In rural mills such as Arkwright's, attracting labour was crucial. Yearly wage increases incentivized loyalty and ensured workforce stability, despite potential mismatches between wages and worker productivity.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了工业革命早期棉纺工厂中的性别工资差距与工资设定机制，重点关注位于德比郡贝克韦尔的理查德·阿克莱特朗姆福德工厂。研究将工厂工资簿中的工人记录与教区洗礼记录进行关联，以估算年龄并构建纺纱部门的年龄—工资曲线。研究发现，性别工资差距在成年期显著显现，女性工资停滞不前，而男性则晋升至监工等薪酬更高的职位，表明女性的晋升机会有限。然而，在童工中几乎没有发现性别工资歧视的证据。纺纱劳动力在成年期形成的性别分化是工资差距的主要原因。分析还显示，儿童的周工资率在成年之前逐年递增。在像阿克莱特这样的乡村工厂中，吸引劳动力至关重要。年度工资增长激励了忠诚度并确保了劳动力队伍的稳定，尽管工资与工人生产率之间可能存在不匹配。

title: Riding the Housing Wave: Home Equity Withdrawal and Consumer Debt Composition
title_zh: 驾驭住房浪潮：房屋净值提取与消费者债务构成
title_primary: 驾驭住房浪潮：房屋净值提取与消费者债务构成
title_secondary: Riding the Housing Wave: Home Equity Withdrawal and Consumer Debt Composition
authors: ANNA GRODECKA‐MESSI, JIEYING LI, XIN ZHANG
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2025-11-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using a monthly panel data set of individuals' debt, we show that house price changes can explain a significant fraction of personal debt composition dynamics. We exploit the variation in local house price growth as shocks to homeowners' housing wealth to study the consequential adjustment of debt portfolio. We present direct evidence that homeowners reoptimize their debt structure by using parts of withdrawn home equity to pay down comparatively expensive nonmortgage debt during a housing boom. The effect is strongest for homeowners that have a high debt‐to‐income ratio and live in a municipality with a high literacy level. We find evidence that macroprudential policy and interest rates are important for consumer debt decisions.
abstract_zh: 利用个人债务的月度面板数据，我们证明房价变动能够解释个人债务构成动态的显著部分。我们利用地方房价增长的变化作为房主住房财富的冲击，研究随之而来的债务组合调整。我们提供直接证据表明，在住房繁荣期间，房主通过使用部分提取的房屋净值来偿还相对昂贵的非抵押贷款，从而重新优化其债务结构。这一效应在债务收入比高且居住于识字率较高城市的房主中最为显著。我们发现宏观审慎政策和利率对消费者债务决策具有重要影响的证据。

title: Equilibrium Outcomes and Amenity Valuation in a Multispatial Residential Sorting Framework
title_zh: 多空间居住分选框架中的均衡结果与舒适性价值评估
title_primary: 多空间居住分选框架中的均衡结果与舒适性价值评估
title_secondary: Equilibrium Outcomes and Amenity Valuation in a Multispatial Residential Sorting Framework
authors: Livy, M. R., Klaiber, H. A.
official: 官方在线 2021-09-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article investigates the role of spatial scale in recovering resident preferences and evaluating policy effects after changes in environmental amenities. As homeowners choose locations, different trade-offs occur across spatial scales, which jointly determine observed choices and equilibrium outcomes. To explore these trade-offs, we develop a multispatial residential location choice model at the school attendance boundary and the residential neighborhood levels that demonstrates the spatially varying influence of environmental amenities on location choice. Furthering this analysis, welfare simulations provide evidence that trade-offs interact across space in various ways to shape welfare implications and distributional outcomes arising from policy. JEL Q51C35
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了空间尺度在环境设施变化后恢复居民偏好及评估政策效应中的作用。随着房主选择居住地点，不同空间尺度上会出现各种权衡，这些权衡共同决定了观察到的选择与均衡结果。为探究这些权衡，我们构建了一个涵盖学校招生边界与居住社区层面的多空间居住选址模型，该模型展示了环境设施对选址决策影响的空间差异性。进一步分析中，福利模拟提供了证据，表明权衡在空间上以多种方式相互作用，从而塑造了政策引发的福利影响及分配结果。JEL Q51C35
